cites.quote: Given the system holds 21 patients, when staff open the first page of the patient list, then it shows 20 per page
slowing down or breaking the existing paging and sort query

findings.text: S-3 AC1 never gives one patient several appointments. The likeliest wrong implementation joins appointments into the paged query, which repeats a patient's row and shifts paging, and AC1 would still pass.
